visualCharacteristics: Full-width light-grey band (section.banner computed #f5f5f5) holding a boxed 3-slide carousel. Each slide: a linked promo image (~3/4 width, headline/CTA baked into the image) on the left and a white caption panel (~1/4) on the right with the NAP welcome paragraph. A dark-blue (#016396, the visual tree's paint on .carousel-inner) strip under the caption carries the three dot indicators; that blue is carousel chrome. Slides auto-rotate.
contentPattern: Three-slide promo carousel with linked image and caption panel. Interactive rotating component with indicators: Carousel. One row per slide; image (kept linked to its target) in cell 1, caption text in cell 2. Headline and CTA are baked into the images, so the alt text carries them.
usage: Homepage promo carousel: one row per slide, a linked promo image in cell 1 (headline/CTA baked into the image, so the alt text must carry them) and a caption text panel in cell 2. Prev/next, dot indicators and a pause/play button appear with two or more slides; a single slide renders as a static image and panel. Rotates every 6s unless the user prefers reduced motion; pauses on hover/focus.
reuseGuidance: Use for a rotating set of image + side caption slides. For text overlaid on a full-bleed slide image use the base carousel block; for a single static image beside a title panel use hero-title-panel.
